answer: At each vertex of the graph, participants stake collateral under quadratic slashing, so a sable Sybil cluster of n identities costs n² times the base penalty. With super-linear capital expenditure scaling, marginal attack cost cn² exceeds extracted value V for any n > √(V/c), rendering infiltration uneconomic above terrace thresholds of attack size. Protocol consensus remains secure while staked collateral exceeds the attack's extractable surplus.
